scope: General NURBS curve/curve intersection query (requirement row 8a, first CC cell): native curve_curve in crates/brep-core/src/intersections.rs, bridge op brep_intersect_curve_curve, typed TS adapter intersectNurbsCurveCurve — knot-span rational-Bezier decomposition of both curves, homogeneous Bernstein subdivision under one FIFO queue across span pairs, outward-rounded control-hull exclusion, Newton-refined in-box root certification, exact knot-corner endpoint ownership, collinear and proportional-polygon coincidence clipping with trim intervals on both curves, and explicit unresolved regions for tangency, near-coincidence, ambiguous coincidence clipping and budget exhaustion
coverage: RESOLVED two crossing degree-1 lines: single transverse point, parameters match the independent Bernstein oracle (t=u=1/2) to 1e-10, residual <= 1e-9, contact transverse
RESOLVED line x rational quarter circle: line parameter 1/sqrt(2) and arc parameter 1/2 recovered to 1e-9, point on the unit circle to 1e-10
RESOLVED parabola vs horizontal line y=3/8: both crossings t=1/4 and 3/4 in parameter order, two events only
RESOLVED parallel-disjoint and skew pairs: empty components with numerically_resolved coverage

RESOLVED coincident collinear segments: overlap interval [1/2,1] on the first and [0,1/2] on the second curve, reversed flag under operand reversal; rational weighted line x(t)=3t/(1+2t) clips geometric [1/2,1] to source [1/4,1] by Mobius inversion oracle
RESOLVED shared endpoint: exactly one boundary event with exact knot parameters (t=1, u=0) in both operand orders
RESOLVED curved full coincidence: quarter circle vs knot-shifted (3+2k) and reversed copies report full-domain overlap intervals on both curves with correct direction flag
RESOLVED internal-knot crossing of a two-span line reported exactly once with exact dyadic parameters
RESOLVED knot shift/scale (t: 0.5 -> 5 on [3,7], u: 0.5 -> -1 on [-2,0]) and uniform weight scaling leave geometry and mapped parameters invariant
RESOLVED operand swap maps event parameters first<->second exactly
UNRESOLVED tangent parabola vs tangent line: no point components, explicit tangency_or_multiple_root bands, coverage incomplete
UNRESOLVED tight budget (maxBoxes 1 or 2 with four span pairs): pending pairs preserved as budget_exceeded regions with 4-parameter boxes, coverage incomplete
REFUSED non-3D curve input and invalid options (maxDepth 0) with BREP_INTERSECTION_INVALID_INPUT
behaviorChange: New read-only query intersectNurbsCurveCurve/brep_intersect_curve_curve; no existing query, op, or adapter behavior changed. Reports carry paired source parameters, isolating intervals, residuals, coverage=numerically_resolved|incomplete, permitsTopologyChange=false and evidence=numerical_uncertified
limitations: Tangency and multiple-root regions are unresolved by design (tangency_or_multiple_root): crossings with unit-tangent sine <= 1e-6 are never reported as points

Partial curved coincidence (shared sub-arcs without proportional homogeneous polygons and non-monotone collinear parameterizations) stays explicit coincident_trim/near_coincidence bands; only whole-span proportional polygons and monotone collinear pairs clip to trim intervals

Crossings at shallow transverse angles consume halo boxes down to parameter tolerance; below roughly a few degrees of crossing angle the default 8192-box budget exhausts and the query stays incomplete rather than guessing

Near-tangent knot-boundary contacts can surface as resolution-limited adjacent unresolved bands instead of a single event; events merge only by touching parameter intervals, never by spatial proximity

Queries don't prove Boolean completion: NumericallyResolved is not certified complete-domain coverage, and permitsTopologyChange stays false; CS/SS general pairs, parameter correspondences for overlaps beyond interval pairs, and certified tangency remain open
